payload.details: iOS Safari WebCodecs VideoEncoder does not support AVC1 High profile in offscreen workers without hardware acceleration fallback.

escalation.escalation_message: Detected hardware-level sandbox restriction on iOS Safari worker video encoding. Autonomous fallback to WASM software encoder exceeds memory budget (512MB). Requesting human engineering lead decision on codec degradation vs server-side rendering architecture.
options_for_human: 1. Fallback to server-side Remotion rendering pipeline for iOS clients
2. Restrict export resolution to 720p Baseline profile on mobile Safari
3. Display explicit unsupported browser alert for iOS tactical export
